 Baseball: Hanshin's Triple Crown winner Sato to be posted for MLB move
 KYODO NEWS 
 - Oct 19, 2026 - 17:37 
 All , Sports 
 File photo shows Teruaki Sato of the Hanshin Tigers hitting a home run during a baseball game against the Yomiuri Giants in Nishinomiya, Japan, in May 2026. (Kyodo) 
 TOKYO - The Hanshin Tigers announced Monday they have approved star third baseman Teruaki Sato seeking a move to Major League Baseball via the posting system this offseason.
 Sato won the Central League's Triple Crown this season with 39 home runs, 106 RBIs and a .306 batting average for the Tigers, who clinched the CL pennant for the second straight year before losing to the DeNA BayStars in the CL Climax Series.
